newest.headline: News banners, the Caramel badge, and a home screen that fits

items.text: News posts name their own banner art: emergency, urgent, Christmas, Caramel+ and BerryAPI.
The Caramel badge shows next to friends who run the client.
The hero buttons no longer overlap the art, the news column scrolls, and the side card fills its column.
Builds share one signing key, so updates install over the old version.
A session counts as live from the moment it starts.

upcoming.headline: What is being worked on next

items.text: The sign-in hand-off for Bedrock 1.26.60, which still needs a real phone and a real Microsoft account to confirm.
The replay recorder capturing the full world from BerryAPI's native world feed, not only the local player and voice peers.
BerryAPI's encrypted voice system, replacing the launcher's own relay settings.
